Grubtech.overview: Connects online ordering channels to Foodics POS and adds kitchen management and delivery dispatch in one platform. 300+ integrations.
Grubtech.bestFor: Multi-brand operators and cloud kitchens that want order flow, kitchen tracking and dispatch together.
Grubtech.unit: gOnline License per branch (main line). Virtual Brand add-on for each extra brand on the same branch.
Grubtech.edge: Live order tracking from prep to dispatch; multi-brand, multi-location from one setup; widest integration list.
Grubtech.watch: Menu sync is the most common support issue. Confirm menu setup ownership before go-live.
rules: Each additional brand on a branch = 1 Virtual Brand line.

Deliverect.overview: Connects online ordering channels to Foodics POS so orders and menus are managed in one place, with sales and third-party delivery analytics.
Deliverect.bestFor: Brands that care most about central menu control and channel analytics.
Deliverect.unit: Physical License per physical branch; Virtual License per virtual branch.
Deliverect.edge: Strongest menu management with location-specific variations; real-time sales analytics across channels.
Deliverect.watch: Highest price in the category. Annual only in Salesforce.
rules: 1 Physical License per physical branch (includes 1 physical branch).
1 Virtual License per virtual branch (includes 1 virtual branch).

UrbanPiper.overview: Connects online ordering channels to Foodics POS; control menus, stock availability and business data across platforms and outlets.
UrbanPiper.bestFor: Price-sensitive merchants, and the only aggregator-management option for Egypt.
UrbanPiper.unit: Subscription License per outlet. '1 Channel' license for merchants on a single aggregator.
UrbanPiper.edge: Lowest entry price in KSA; real-time stock availability across outlets.
UrbanPiper.watch: The 1 Channel line has no SAR price. It can't be quoted in KSA.
rules: 1 Channel variant is limited to one channel and has no KSA price.

FeedUs.overview: Connects HungerStation, Jahez, Mrsool and other online channels to Foodics POS; unified menu control and branch-specific provider mapping.
FeedUs.bestFor: KSA merchants whose orders come from local Saudi aggregators.
FeedUs.edge: Local-aggregator focus and branch-level provider assignments.
FeedUs.watch: SAR only. Not sellable outside KSA.

BrandWallet.overview: Digital loyalty cards (stamp, multi-stamp, point, tiered) with automated rewards, coupons, location push alerts and QR table tents.
BrandWallet.bestFor: Cafés and QSRs that want wallet loyalty cards live fast, in any country.
BrandWallet.unit: One plan for the main branch plus one Additional Branch line per extra branch.
BrandWallet.edge: Plans are tiered by number of cards: Basic 1, Standard 2, Growth 5.
BrandWallet.watch: License count must equal branch count. 6 branches = 1 plan + 5 Additional Branch.
rules: 1 Main plan (Basic / Standard / Growth) + (branches − 1) Additional Branch.
Additional Branch works with all plans.

Koinz.overview: Loyalty plus customer feedback, growth analytics, retargeting, and online ordering for pickup and delivery.
Koinz.bestFor: KSA or Egypt merchants who want loyalty, feedback and their own ordering in one package.
Koinz.edge: WhatsApp messaging in KSA, SMS in Egypt; Apple Wallet; built-in ordering.
Koinz.watch: Priced in SAR and EGP only.
rules: WhatsApp is KSA only; SMS is Egypt only.

OptCulture.overview: AI-powered loyalty and CRM: interactive digital receipts, personalized loyalty, automated campaigns, Apple and Google Wallet cards, Customer 360.
OptCulture.bestFor: Mid-to-large brands that want a CRM with segmentation and automated campaigns, not just a stamp card.
OptCulture.unit: Loyalty or Growth license, plus messaging billed per usage.
OptCulture.edge: Growth adds pre-built WhatsApp, SMS and email promotional campaigns on top of Loyalty.
OptCulture.watch: SMS and WhatsApp are charged per message on top of the license. Tell the merchant up front.
rules: Choose Loyalty or Growth (Growth includes all Loyalty features).
Add SMS Usage and/or WhatsApp Usage lines (per message, GCC).

Prepit.overview: Behavior-based loyalty rewards, automated promotions and SMS, plus online ordering, payments and a waiter app.
Prepit.bestFor: Egyptian merchants who want loyalty and ordering together.
Prepit.unit: Basic or Advanced license for the main branch + Additional Branch lines; Delivery Module and Mobile App add-ons.
Prepit.edge: Advanced adds loyalty points, commercial account management and instant rewards.
Prepit.watch: EGP only in Salesforce. Advanced and Mobile App are high-value lines.
rules: 1 Main license (Basic or Advanced) + (branches − 1) matching Additional Branch.
Additional Branch must match the main tier.

Ordable.overview: 0% commission online store connected to Foodics POS, with 60+ features, delivery, payment gateways and social marketing tools.
Ordable.bestFor: Kuwait merchants who want their own branded ordering store.
Ordable.unit: Basic or Advance license + Additional Branch; Mobile Application add-on.
Ordable.edge: 0% commission; deep feature set; strong in Kuwait.
Ordable.watch: Priced in KWD and JOD only. No KSA or UAE price.
rules: Mobile Application is an optional add-on.

Zyda.overview: Direct ordering website set up in 24 hours at 0% commission, with one dashboard for orders, stock, delivery and marketing.
Zyda.bestFor: Merchants in UAE, Kuwait or Egypt who want a fast, low-effort web store.
Zyda.unit: Basic includes 1 branch; Advanced includes 3 branches; Additional Branch for each extra; Mobile Application add-on.
Zyda.edge: Advanced already covers 3 branches, which is cheaper than stacking branches on Basic.
Zyda.watch: No SAR or JOD price. Can't be quoted in KSA or Jordan.
rules: Extra branches beyond what's included = Additional Branch lines.

Mnasati.overview: Own online store live in about 24 hours; syncs menu, branches, customers and orders with Foodics.
Mnasati.bestFor: Kuwait merchants who need a store fast and know their catalog size.
Mnasati.edge: Tiered by catalog size: Premium allows 50 main and 150 sub categories, 1,500 products and bulk upload.
Mnasati.watch: No SAR price in Salesforce, even though KSA is listed as a working country.
rules: One package line (Basic or Premium) chosen by catalog size.

wi-Q.overview: Modular ordering: Connect, Online Ordering and Table (QR) Ordering.
wi-Q.bestFor: Dine-in venues that want QR table ordering, or a modular online ordering setup.
wi-Q.unit: Module licenses: Connect, Online Ordering, Table Ordering.
wi-Q.edge: The only partner here with QR table ordering, and the only one with Monthly, Quarterly, Semi-annual and Annual options.
wi-Q.watch: Table Ordering is the highest-priced module. Quote modules separately.
rules: Quote each module as its own line.
Connect is available Monthly, Quarterly, Semi-annual and Annual.

ShopBrain.overview: Real-time inventory with AI demand planning, a restaurant accounting module and F&B expert insights.
ShopBrain.bestFor: Single and multi-branch restaurants that want solid inventory at a mid price, with optional accounting.
ShopBrain.unit: Tier per branch: Essential, Operation or Enterprise. Main license + Additional Branch. Accounting add-on (main + additional). Cost Center per warehouse or central kitchen.
ShopBrain.edge: Operation adds the full PR/PO cycle; Enterprise adds advanced adjustments and COGS. The accounting add-on runs on the same POS data.
ShopBrain.watch: Essential has only Additional Branch lines in Salesforce, so the Essential main license is missing. Confirm before quoting Essential.
rules: 1 Main (tier) + (branches − 1) Additional Branch of the same tier.
Accounting: 1 Accounting Main + (branches − 1) Accounting Additional Branch.
Each warehouse or central kitchen = 1 Cost Center.
Annual, Quarterly, or Monthly for additional lines.

Supy.overview: Inventory, smart procurement, invoices and supplier settlements, recipe and menu engineering, and BI on Foodics sales data.
Supy.bestFor: Groups with central kitchens that want procurement, recipe costing and supplier control.
Supy.unit: Regular Outlet License per outlet; Central Kitchen License per central kitchen; Extra Cost Center; one-time Onboarding Fee.
Supy.edge: Deepest procurement and recipe-costing features in the category.
Supy.watch: Minimum 3 licenses. The onboarding fee is one-time and can't be discounted. About 2× ShopBrain Operation per outlet.
rules: 1 Regular Outlet per outlet; 1 Central Kitchen per central kitchen.
Add the one-time Onboarding Fee on new business.

Wafeq.overview: Cloud accounting that syncs Foodics sales; VAT returns, invoicing and payroll.
Wafeq.bestFor: Saudi and UAE merchants who want local, VAT-ready accounting.
Wafeq.unit: Premium (1 branch only) or Enterprise (includes 3 branches) + Additional Branch on Enterprise only.
Wafeq.edge: Local Arabic-first product; Enterprise covers 3 branches in one license.
Wafeq.watch: Premium can't take extra branches. With 2+ branches, quote Enterprise.

Xero.overview: Xero subscription sold directly, with an optional Hesab Arabic interface and separate training and support packages.
Xero.bestFor: Merchants who already know Xero or need international accounting.
Xero.unit: Main Subscription + Additional Branch; Hesab Arabic Interface add-on; Training and Support packages (one-time).
Xero.edge: Global brand; Arabic interface available as an add-on.
Xero.watch: Training and support are NOT included. Quote them separately if the merchant needs help.
rules: Training and Support are separate one-time lines.

Alpha (Xero).overview: Xero delivered by implementation partner Alpha: subscription plus implementation, migration and training.
Alpha (Xero).bestFor: Merchants who want Xero fully set up for them: chart of accounts, templates, integrations.
Alpha (Xero).unit: Basic or Premium Subscription + Additional Branch; Implementation (one-time), Migration Package, Training Sessions.
Alpha (Xero).edge: Done-for-you setup and up to 1 year of historical data migration.
Alpha (Xero).watch: Don't quote Xero direct and Alpha (Xero) to the same merchant. Pick one route. Implementation is one-time and can't be discounted.

QuickBooks.overview: QuickBooks Online Plus with separate training and support packages.
QuickBooks.unit: Online Plus Subscription + Additional Branch; Training and Support (one-time).
QuickBooks.watch: Training and support are not included.
rules: Training and Support are separate one-time lines.

FlowERP.overview: Finance and ERP that syncs Foodics sales into accounting: automated journals, inventory lifecycle, COGS, ZATCA e-invoicing.
FlowERP.bestFor: KSA small and mid-size groups that need a real ERP without SAP-level cost.
FlowERP.unit: Basic or Advanced Package + matching Additional Branch; Implementation per branch (one-time); add-ons (HR, Cost Center, Central Kitchen, B2B Invoicing and more).
FlowERP.edge: Advanced adds assets, production (assembly), waste and payroll. Modular add-ons.
FlowERP.watch: Additional Branch must match the package. Implementation is per branch.
rules: 1 Package (Basic / Advanced) + (branches − 1) Additional Branch of the SAME package.

SAP.overview: SAP Business One for F&B groups: Pro and Limited users, hosting, Foodics integration, maintenance (AMC), implementation.
SAP.unit: Users (Pro / Limited: annual, monthly or perpetual one-time) + Hosting + Foodics Integration + AMC + Implementation per engineer-day. B1 Bundle = 1 brand, up to 5 users + 1 indirect user.
SAP.edge: Most complete ERP; the B1 Bundle simplifies quoting for a single brand.
SAP.watch: Many components. Use the B1 Bundle for a single brand with 5 users or fewer.
rules: Count Pro and Limited users separately.
Always add Hosting + Foodics Integration unless the merchant self-hosts.

MS Dynamics.overview: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance with Foodics integration.
MS Dynamics.unit: Finance or Premium license + Attach licenses + Team Members + Foodics Integration + Implementation (one-time).
MS Dynamics.watch: The Foodics Integration line is required for the POS sync.
rules: Base license (Finance or Premium) + optional Attach and Team Member.

VOLT.overview: HR, payroll, attendance and self-service suite with SAP finance integration.
VOLT.bestFor: SAP customers who need HR and payroll.
VOLT.unit: Per-module licenses (HR, Payroll, Attendance, ESS, Company Admin, Superuser, Dashboard, Mobile per user) in Annual, Monthly or One-time; Hosting with SAP; Implementation.
VOLT.watch: Several Monthly lines have inconsistent prices across currencies (flagged ⚠). Verify in Salesforce before quoting.
rules: Quote per module and per user where the line says per user.
Pick one billing model (Annual, Monthly or One-time) for all modules.

Malachite.overview: HR, payroll, attendance and employee self-service licenses.
Malachite.watch: Not a stand-alone solution. It must be activated with SAP.

InvoiceQ.overview: Compliant B2B and B2C e-invoicing from Foodics POS with tax-authority integration, credit and debit notes, and approval workflows.
InvoiceQ.bestFor: KSA and Jordan merchants who need ZATCA-compliant invoicing per terminal.
InvoiceQ.unit: Licensed per account (not per branch). Basic = email only, up to 2 terminals. Advanced = unlimited invoicing + 2,000 SMS/year, per issuing terminal. Customization one-time.
InvoiceQ.edge: Terminal-based model fits merchants with few issuing points.
InvoiceQ.watch: Advanced is per issuing terminal. Count terminals, not branches. Customization is one-time and can't be discounted.
rules: Basic: one account line covers up to 2 terminals.

Iisal.overview: Digital receipts: POS transactions become compliant e-invoices sent by SMS, with sales dashboards, consumer insights and a loyalty program.
Iisal.bestFor: Merchants who want paperless SMS receipts plus customer insights.
Iisal.unit: Licensed per account (not per branch). Tier by yearly invoice volume: up to 100, up to 500, 500+.
Iisal.edge: Receipts double as a customer-data and loyalty channel. ZATCA Phase 1 and 2.
Iisal.watch: Pick the tier by invoice volume, not by branch count.
rules: One account line, tier chosen by invoice volume.

Servme.overview: Reservations and seat management, waitlist, CRM guest profiles and booking widget.
Servme.bestFor: Dine-in and fine-dining venues that take reservations.
Servme.unit: Black Plan (Monthly, Quarterly, Semi-annual, Annual) or Advanced Plan (Annual) + one-time Onboarding Fee.
Servme.edge: Only table-management partner; flexible billing frequency.
Servme.watch: The onboarding fee is one-time and can't be discounted.
rules: One plan line + Onboarding Fee on new business.

Ishbek.watch: Priced in KWD and JOD only.

Roboost.bestFor: Merchants running their own delivery fleet.
Roboost.watch: Confirm the billing unit with Partnerships before quoting.
rules: Confirm the unit (per order or per driver) first.

Nitx.watch: Partner is DEACTIVATED. Do not quote.
